title: 植物克隆：组织培养入门
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/05_APB - Plant Cloning.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/05_APB - Plant Cloning/src.py

points.K1: 有了新基因，还要长成新植株
points.K3: 培养基提供营养和激素
points.K6: 第一步：取材，诱导胚状体
points.K7: 第二步：分开，转到生根培养基
points.K8: 第三步：长成小植株，再驯化
points.S5: 转基因植物材料不外带、不乱扔

shots.scene: 欣欣站在培养架前，架上一排培养瓶里长着小绿苗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a shelf of glass culture jars with tiny green plantlets inside and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲植物克隆：组织培养入门。
overlay: 植物克隆：组织培养入门

shots.scene: 一片叶子、一团细胞、一株小苗、一盆植物四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row connected by arrows: a small leaf piece, a cluster of cells, a tiny plantlet and a potted plant. No people.
shots.narration: 一小块组织，能长成一整株植物。

shots.scene: 阿杰捧着一个培养瓶，瓶里只有一小片绿色组织
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a glass culture jar containing only a tiny piece of green plant tissue on gel, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰不信：这一小片，能长成植物？

shots.scene: 小研拿出几个培养阶段不同的瓶子排成一排
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lines up several culture jars showing different stages from tiny tissue to small plantlets.
shots.narration: 小研摆出一排瓶子：你看它怎么长。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这就是植物组织培养。

shots.section_title: 有了新基因，还要长成新植株
shots.scene: 一个植物细胞里亮起新的基因片段
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a plant cell with a newly inserted glowing gene segment inside. No people.
shots.narration: 植物细胞导入了想要的基因，
overlay: 有了新基因，还要长成新植株

shots.section_title: 有了新基因，还要长成新植株
shots.scene: 一个细胞变成一片植株群体，每株都带亮点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of one plant cell growing into a group of young plants, each with a small glowing mark. No people.
shots.narration: 还得长成新植株，基因才能在群体中表达。

shots.scene: 瓶口包着锡箔的玻璃培养瓶，里面是绿苗
shots.prompt_en: A glass culture jar with its mouth covered by foil and small green plantlets growing on gel inside. No people.
shots.narration: 组织培养，也叫微繁殖。

shots.scene: 试管图标旁边写着“离体”标记
shots.prompt_en: A test tube icon with a tiny plant tissue inside and a dashed outline showing it is outside the plant body. No people.
shots.narration: 在试管里离体培养植物组织。

shots.scene: 一个细胞长成整株植物的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a single plant cell gradually becoming a whole plant through several stages. No people.
shots.narration: 理论上，一个细胞就能再生出整株植物。

shots.section_title: 培养基提供营养和激素
shots.scene: 一小块组织旁边的营养和激素电量条都很低
shots.prompt_en: A tiny piece of plant tissue next to two low battery bars marked with a sugar cube icon and a hormone drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 组织太小，自身养分和激素不够用。
overlay: 培养基提供营养和激素

shots.section_title: 培养基提供营养和激素
shots.scene: 组织放在半透明的琼脂上，糖块和激素滴渗入
shots.prompt_en: A tiny tissue piece resting on clear agar gel, with sugar cube icons and hormone drop icons seeping in. No people.
shots.narration: 所以放在含糖和激素的琼脂上。

shots.section_title: 培养基提供营养和激素
shots.scene: 琼脂里的水滴和养分颗粒流向细胞
shots.prompt_en: Water droplets and nutrient dots flowing from the gel into the cells. No people.
shots.narration: 琼脂提供水分和养分，让细胞增殖。

shots.scene: 试管里一团黄色无序的细胞团
shots.prompt_en: A test tube with a pale yellow lumpy mass of unorganized cells on gel. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞增殖成一团无序的细胞，

shots.scene: 放大后的细胞团，像一堆小泡泡
shots.prompt_en: Magnified view of the cell mass looking like a cluster of round bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 这团细胞，叫愈伤组织。

shots.scene: 愈伤组织上长出小根和小芽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the callus sprouting tiny white roots below and small green shoots above. No people.
shots.narration: 再换含生长素的培养基，诱导分化。

shots.scene: 细胞分化成根、茎、叶的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of cells differentiating into root, stem and leaf tissues. No people.
shots.narration: 长出根、分生组织，形成各种组织器官。

shots.scene: 一株植物上多个部位被圈出来
shots.prompt_en: A plant diagram with several parts circled: shoot tip, root tip, leaf, flower bud, seed and fruit. No people.
shots.narration: 只要是活组织，哪个部位都能用。

shots.scene: 茎尖和嫩叶被放大，打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a shoot tip and a young leaf with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 茎尖、分生组织、嫩叶，成功率最高。

shots.scene: 根尖、花药、花芽、种子、果实图标排一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a root tip, an anther, a flower bud, a seed and a fruit. No people.
shots.narration: 根尖、花药、花芽、种子、果实也可以。

shots.section_title: 第一步：取材，诱导胚状体
shots.scene: 小研在花盆前挑选一株最壮的植物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student examines several potted plants and chooses the healthiest one.
shots.narration: 第一步，从性状优良的母株上取材。
overlay: 第一步：取材，诱导胚状体

shots.section_title: 第一步：取材，诱导胚状体
shots.scene: 小研在超净工作台里把组织放到培养基上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in lab coat and gloves, places a small tissue piece onto a culture medium inside a clean bench.
shots.narration: 在无菌环境里，把组织放到培养基上，

shots.section_title: 第一步：取材，诱导胚状体
shots.scene: 组织上冒出几个小小的胚状体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of tiny embryo-like green bumps forming on the tissue. No people.
shots.narration: 诱导它形成胚状体。

shots.section_title: 第二步：分开，转到生根培养基
shots.scene: 一簇胚状体被镊子轻轻分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a cluster of small green embryos being gently separated by forceps. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，把成簇的胚状体分开。
overlay: 第二步：分开，转到生根培养基

shots.section_title: 第二步：分开，转到生根培养基
shots.scene: 单个胚状体被移到新的培养瓶里
shots.prompt_en: A single small embryo being moved by forceps into a fresh culture jar. No people.
shots.narration: 在无菌环境中，一个个转到新培养基。

shots.section_title: 第二步：分开，转到生根培养基
shots.scene: 新培养瓶标签处画着根的图标和激素滴
shots.prompt_en: A fresh culture jar with a blank label, a small root icon and a hormone drop icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这是含营养和生根激素的生根培养基。

shots.section_title: 第三步：长成小植株，再驯化
shots.scene: 胚状体长出根和芽，变成小植株
shots.prompt_en: Time-lapse style diagram of an embryo growing roots and shoots into a small plantlet. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，激素促进根和芽生长，
overlay: 第三步：长成小植株，再驯化

shots.section_title: 第三步：长成小植株，再驯化
shots.scene: 培养瓶里一株株小苗
shots.prompt_en: A culture jar with several small plantlets standing on gel. No people.
shots.narration: 形成小植株，并逐渐长大。

shots.section_title: 第三步：长成小植株，再驯化
shots.scene: 小苗移到温室小盆里，盖着透明罩
shots.prompt_en: Small plantlets moved into little pots under a clear plastic dome in a greenhouse. No people.
shots.narration: 小苗娇嫩易病，先在受控环境里驯化。

shots.section_title: 第三步：长成小植株，再驯化
shots.scene: 小苗长大移到户外田间
shots.prompt_en: Young plants growing larger and finally planted outdoors in a field. No people.
shots.narration: 能适应正常环境后，再移栽出去。

shots.scene: 温度计、灯泡、营养颗粒、激素滴四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a thermometer, a light bulb, nutrient pellets and a hormone drop. No people.
shots.narration: 培养条件要调控：温度、光照、营养、激素。

shots.scene: 培养室里一排架子，灯光柔和
shots.prompt_en: A plant growth room with neat shelves of culture jars under soft lights. No people.
shots.narration: 需求和普通植物一样，只是更照顾幼嫩细胞。

shots.scene: 一小块组织变出一大片小苗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of one tiny tissue piece multiplying into a large tray full of plantlets. No people.
shots.narration: 优点一：少量组织，就能大量繁殖。

shots.scene: 组培苗和种子繁殖并排赛跑，组培苗领先
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of two tracks: a culture jar plantlet racing ahead of a seed sprout. No people.
shots.narration: 多数物种，比有性繁殖更快。

shots.scene: 一株稀有植物和一个难繁殖的植物图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rare precious plant and a hard-to-propagate plant, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 材料稀少、常规难繁殖的，也能用它。

shots.scene: 小苗周围的病菌图标被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: Small plantlets inside a jar with germ icons kept outside a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 通常还能得到不带病的植株。

shots.scene: 钱币、时钟和专用设备图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of coins, a clock and a clean bench equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 缺点：需要专门设备和技能，费钱费工。

shots.scene: DNA双螺旋上一处颜色异常
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon with one segment in an unusual color and a small warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 植株可能发生遗传突变。

shots.scene: 移到户外的小苗蔫了
shots.prompt_en: A small plantlet wilting after being moved outdoors. No people.
shots.narration: 早期很脆弱，可能适应不了正常环境。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处荧光笔标记和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with three highlighted lines and a question mark in the margin. No people.
shots.narration: 划出三条要点，连上旧知识，写下疑问。

shots.scene: 培养瓶里的蕨类小苗
shots.prompt_en: A culture jar with small fern plantlets growing inside. No people.
shots.narration: 下一个活动，用组培繁殖蕨类植物。

shots.scene: 一小片蕨叶变成整株蕨的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a tiny fern piece growing into a complete fern plant. No people.
shots.narration: 体会植物细胞的全能性。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个超净工作台图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an icon of a laminar flow clean bench.
shots.narration: 无菌技术，下一课专门讲。

shots.scene: 解剖刀和镊子放在无菌托盘上
shots.prompt_en: A scalpel and forceps resting on a clean tray. No people.
shots.narration: 组培要用解剖刀和镊子，刀片很锋利。

shots.scene: 小研用镊子夹住组织，刀口朝外、朝下切
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, holds tissue with forceps and cuts with the blade pointing down and away from her hand.
shots.narration: 用镊子固定材料，刀口朝下、朝外切。

shots.scene: 徒手装卸刀片的图标被打叉，旁边是拆刀器
shots.prompt_en: Icon of bare fingers changing a scalpel blade crossed out with a red X, next to a blade remover tool with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 装卸刀片用工具，不用手指捏。

shots.scene: 用过的刀片投进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: A used blade dropped into a yellow sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 用完的刀片，放进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 小研翻看激素试剂的空白安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet beside a small hormone reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 激素母液和培养基试剂，先查说明书。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套、口罩在天平前称量粉末
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, goggles and a mask, weighs a small amount of powder on a balance.
shots.narration: 称量配制戴好防护，粉末别扬起。

shots.scene: 储液瓶贴着空白标签，放进冰箱
shots.prompt_en: A stock solution bottle with a blank label placed into a lab refrigerator. No people.
shots.narration: 母液贴好标签，按要求存放。

shots.scene: 乙醇瓶、酒精灯和高压灭菌器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an ethanol bottle, an alcohol lamp and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒灭菌要用乙醇、明火和灭菌器。

shots.scene: 乙醇瓶靠近火焰的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an ethanol bottle placed next to an open flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醇易燃，远离火焰，用完盖好。

shots.scene: 王老师带阿杰在高压灭菌器前看空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the young male student a blank operating procedure posted beside an autoclave.
shots.narration: 灭菌器要培训后才能用，具体下一课讲。

shots.scene: 一个培养瓶里长出一团毛茸茸的霉菌
shots.prompt_en: A culture jar with a fuzzy mold colony growing on the gel. No people.
shots.narration: 培养瓶长了霉、长了菌，

shots.scene: 打开污染瓶盖子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand opening the lid of a moldy culture jar, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要打开闻、打开看，

shots.scene: 污染瓶整瓶放进灭菌袋，送进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Closed contaminated jars placed in an autoclave bag and loaded into an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 整瓶高压灭菌后，再按规定处置。

shots.section_title: 转基因植物材料不外带、不乱扔
shots.scene: 一个转基因幼苗培养瓶，旁边是法规书本
shots.prompt_en: A culture jar with a transgenic plantlet next to a closed law book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 导入了新基因的植物，按转基因材料管理。
overlay: 转基因植物材料不外带、不乱扔

shots.section_title: 转基因植物材料不外带、不乱扔
shots.scene: 培养瓶被装进书包带出门、送给朋友的图标，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a culture jar being put into a backpack and handed to a friend outside, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不带出实验室，不送人，不随意种植。

shots.section_title: 转基因植物材料不外带、不乱扔
shots.scene: 老周在空白登记本上记录，旁边是灭活后的废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The older man writes in a blank register beside a sealed bag of sterilized plant waste.
shots.narration: 登记去向，废弃材料灭活后处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现组织、愈伤组织、小苗图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a tissue piece, a callus and a plantlet.
shots.narration: 组织到愈伤，愈伤到小苗，再到成株。

shots.scene: 温度计、灯泡、营养、激素图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thermometer, a light bulb, nutrients and a hormone drop, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 无菌操作，调控温光营养激素。

shots.scene: 加号和减号两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A plus sign icon and a minus sign icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 繁殖快、无病苗，但费钱、会突变。

shots.scene: 锐器盒、乙醇瓶和灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sharps container, an ethanol bottle and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 刀片入盒，乙醇远火，污染瓶先灭菌。

shots.scene: 转基因幼苗瓶和锁图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a transgenic plantlet jar and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因材料，不外带、不乱扔。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一盆小植物挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small potted plant and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 小小组织，大大学问，下次见！
